**How the nodules were found**  
The doctors told me the adrenal nodules were seen on an imaging study that was done while they were looking at something else. It wasn’t something I was feeling; it was an “incidental” finding on the scan.

**Symptoms I’ve had**  
- I have noticed a mild darkening of the skin over my finger joints and my knees.  
- I have **not** had any fever, night sweats, or cough.  
- I haven’t felt unusually tired, lost weight, had low blood pressure, gotten dizzy when I stand up, craved salty foods, or had nausea.  

Those are the only changes I’ve noticed so far.
